definition: a state of physical or mental inactivity; lethargy
example: The heat left everyone in a torpor.

definition: easy to control or influence
example: The tractable horse made an excellent mount.

definition: eagerness to argue or fight; bellicosity
example: His truculence made negotiations impossible.

definition: wickedness; depravity
example: He was charged with moral turpitude.

definition: a beginner or novice
example: Even a tyro can master the basics in a week.

definition: general or widespread dislike or reprobation
example: He earned the odium of his peers after the leak.

definition: not guided by conscience; shockingly unreasonable
example: The unconscionable delay enraged the travelers.

definition: to take a position of power or importance without right or permission
example: The general usurped the throne.

definition: to waver between different opinions or actions
example: She vacillated between accepting and refusing the offer.

definition: accorded a great deal of respect, especially because of age
example: The venerable elder addressed the village.

definition: the appearance of being true or real
example: The film strove for historical verisimilitude.

definition: capable of being conquered or overcome
example: Every army, however mighty, is vincible.

definition: to reduce the force, value, or effect of something
example: The long delay did not attenuate public anger.

definition: to blame or insult someone in strong or violent language
example: He vituperated his rivals in print.

definition: curvaceous and sexually attractive; sensually pleasing
example: The painting depicted a voluptuous figure reclining.

definition: to be conveyed lightly through the air
example: The scent of pine wafted through the cabin.

definition: attractive or appealing in appearance or character
example: Her winsome smile won everyone over.

definition: something regarded as oppressive or restrictive
example: They threw off the yoke of tyranny.

definition: a state of temporary disuse or suspension
example: The project was held in abeyance until funds arrived.

definition: disapproval or censure
example: He earned the approbrium of his peers.

definition: so lacking in originality as to be obvious and boring
example: The film was banal and predictable.

definition: to dress or adorn gaudily or tastelessly
example: The hall was bedizened with gaudy streamers.

definition: to put in a very difficult situation; to besiege
example: The beleaguered mayor faced one crisis after another.

definition: to ask for or get something without paying for it
example: He cadged a free meal from his aunt.

definition: to think deeply about something; to ponder
example: He cogitated on the meaning of the poem.
